title: DRAFT-Biometry:The 5Rs
text:
Biometry: The 5Rs
Modern statistical methods for agricultural sciences

title: Acknowledgements
Preface
text:
This book is about the use of modern statistical methods in the agricultural sciences. Fisher (1948) defined biometry as the “active pursuit of biological knowledge by quantitative methods”. He was the first President of the International Biometric Society (1947). In my undergraduate days, I bought the five volumes of the collected papers of RA Fisher (H.Bennett (1974)).
So this book is about my adventures as a working biometrician on the western frontier of the Australasian Region of the International Biometric Society, working for the Department of Agriculture, Western Australia (1977-2019).
The design of an experiment in the agricultural sciences is the most important step for an agricultural scientist and a biometrician. Fisher gave us the \(3\mathcal{R}s\) of design:
Randomization, replication, and blocking or local control.
I have added another \(2\mathcal{R}s\) for a biometrician to consider

\(\mathcal{R4}\): The work (publications/statistical software) of the statistical scientists from the school of Rothamsted in England, and collaborators in Australia, and New Zealand.
\(\mathcal{R5}\): The \(\textsf{R}\) statistical system R Core Team (2026) and the Rstudio environment Posit team (2026) and the community of statistical scientists. As Wikle et al. (2019) mention in the last line of their acknowledgement that “Finally, we would like to express our appreciation to the whole \(\textsf{R}\) community, upon whose shoulders we stand!”!

The aim is to present case-studies from the real-world and how-to-do scripts using the \(\textsf{R}\) Statistical System within RStudio for the biometrician as a means of providing reproducible research. For the agricultural scientist there are other approaches such as the menus in the Genstat statistical software https://vsni.co.uk/resources/genstat.
The story started in 2008 when we built a pizza oven. 

Many years ago, I had a dream To do what Romans do Make slow food and fast cars I cannot do cars, but I thought a PIZZA oven Introducing ’Tartufo’ (Truffles) the elephant with a heart of gold So began the 5Rs of Biometry …

The first two case-studies and the main e-book is planned to be released on December 1,2026 at the AASC2026 conference https://aasc2026.netlify.app/.
Your interest and patience is most appreciated.
